name: Bonnie Hawk Furniture
old_description: Born in Baltimore, now based in Frederick, Bonnie loves building commission work for Maryland, DC, and Virginia clientele. Inspired by native woods like walnut, ash, and white oak, Bonnie brings a contemporary, Baltimorean charm to a traditional craft.
about:
Bonnie Hawk Furniture operates from Frederick, Maryland, after originating in Baltimore. The business is run by Bonnie Hawk, who builds custom wood pieces on commission for clients across Maryland, Washington, D.C., and Virginia. No founding year is publicly disclosed.

The shop produces custom furniture, boutique porch swings, and offers chair seat weaving and caning services. Porch swings are built for indoor or outdoor use, while the weaving program covers pressed cane, shaker tape, flat reed, splint, and rush for ladder-back chairs, Shaker rockers, and other caned seats. All work is done by hand using native woods such as walnut, ash, and white oak.

Customers are primarily residential clients in the Mid-Atlantic region seeking made-to-order furniture or restoration of existing pieces. Examples include homeowners adding a porch swing to a sunroom or library, and owners of antique chairs needing re-caning.

The company emphasizes a contemporary, Baltimorean take on traditional craft, positioning its swings as the best quality handmade option on the market and highlighting the use of locally sourced native lumber.
